title: Hearing on the economic impact of the 2026 World Cup
summary: The Council will examine how hosting eight 2026 FIFA World Cup matches at MetLife Stadium affected New York City's economy, businesses and budget, hearing from EDC, SBS and the Mayor's World Cup Czar. Council estimates show the City spent about $90 million preparing for the tournament while collecting only about $51 million in added tax revenue, a net loss. A companion resolution calls on FIFA to pay the $1 million “legacy contribution” it promised host cities, which reporting found had not been paid as of August 2026.
